name: Nomi
summary: Relationship-oriented companion with persistent memory, Mind Maps, and in-chat image generation — built for continuity across text, memories, and images rather than quick sessions.
ranking_rationale: Strongest documentation coverage in our record: official homepage, product page, terms, published official prices, and a help wiki. Published $15.99 monthly and $99.99 annual figures. Ranks as the continuity pick; downweighted by the no-nude-photo rule for users whose priority is unrestricted imagery.
